Subject: NovumGen private-hosting scoping — regulatory constraints & netops asks

Alex / Sanjay — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side with the concrete follow-ups we discussed so we keep momentum:  

What NovumGen told us (pain / must-haves):
- Regulatory drive: certain workloads (clinical trial PII) must be processed and stored within a single-country boundary (US-east).
- Air-gap requirement for the on-prem ingest pipeline for raw source data for two regulated studies; long-term archival retention to customer-managed S3/HSM.
- NetOps constraints: only specific egress to vendor update buckets is permitted; static IP allowlist required; no inbound VPNs from public IP ranges.
- Timeline: pilot w/one study in Q4 (target internal kick-off by mid-Oct).

Goals we aligned on:
1) Validate that Redwood Private can be deployed in NovumGen's air-gapped environment (VPC-onprem pattern + optional physical gateway).
2) Produce a concise MOP (minimum operating paper) describing network touchpoints, IP ranges, and the installer footprint so NovumGen NetOps can pre-approve.
3) Agree pilot scope (model selection, dataset residency, telemetry policy, and rollback plan).

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Redwood: send draft mutual-action-plan with high-level scope + proposed pilot success criteria (Evelyn) — by Fri 2026-07-23. Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub).
- Redwood Infra: produce a 1-page network diagram showing allowed egress, required ports and suggested appliance placement (Jonas) — by Tue 2026-07-27.
- NovumGen: share the NetOps contact and any existing IP allowlist constraints (Alex) — as available this week.
- All: schedule a tech deep-dive to validate TLS, KMS integration, and attestations (proposed: week of 2026-07-27).

Questions for NovumGen (short):
- Is the air-gap requirement full physical isolation or a restricted VPC with no internet egress allowed by default?
- Do you have an approved vendor list for islanded appliances (we called out an on-prem shim / gateway during the call)?

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft stub).

Thanks again — I’ll drop the MAP and a short checklist into the Google doc link below and we can iterate.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

1) Air-gap detail: for the clinical trial ingest we require physical isolation from the public internet during the initial 90-day processing window. Post-processing, encrypted artifacts can be replicated to our internal S3 (also US-east) for long-term retention.
2) Approved appliances: we have a short whitelist (they use an internal procurement ID); I’ll send the vendor names and the procurement contact to you by end of day Thursday.

Evelyn / team — adding technical scoping notes for the NetOps checklist I’ll draft. I attached a simple "network-zones-diagram.png" mockup to show the two recommended patterns we discussed (islanded appliance vs VPC-restricted egress). Key asks:  

NetOps-preflight checklist (high level):
- Static IP ranges to be allocated by NovumGen for Redwood egress (we’ll ensure egress uses only these).
- Outbound ports: 443 only (TLS 1.3 preferred); outbound DNS restricted to internal resolver or pinned resolver ip(s).
- No inbound SSH/VPN from the internet to the host; management plane uses a jumpbox inside NovumGen network with strict ACLs.
- KMS integration: we support customer-managed keys (KMIP/HSM); need the endpoint and cert chain for testing.
- Telemetry: we can redact token-level content and only emit operational metrics; confirm retention window for logs (client requested 30 days).

Sizing note (rough): pilot with 1 study (estimate 4 concurrent sessions, burst to 10) — recommend 2x A100-equivalent GPUs in dedicated Private pool for latency SLOs; I’ll put numbers in the MAP.

Attached: network-zones-diagram.png (high-level). I’ll follow up with the one-page installer footprint and a minimal firewall rule list by EOD Tue 7/27.
